177809099.title: File:Las Vegas Strip Skyline Panoramic View The STRAT Hotel Observation Deck.jpg

ObjectName.value: Las Vegas Strip Skyline Panoramic View The STRAT Hotel Observation Deck

Categories.value: Views from Stratosphere Las Vegas|Las Vegas Strip|Las Vegas skylines|Files with coordinates missing SDC location of creation

ImageDescription.value: A panoramic view of the Las Vegas Strip skyline taken from the observation deck of The STRAT Hotel, Casino & Tower in Las Vegas, Nevada. This city scape photo showcases the world famous Las Vegas Strip stretching south towards Westgate Resort and Casino, then behind is the Las Vegas Sphere, in front of the sphere is the elegant Fountainbleau. Flanked next to the Fountainbleau is Resorts World Las Vegas, Encore, Wynn, Circus Circus, and Trump International framed by Las Vegas' Black Mountain range and the under a clear blue sky. Also featured is Harry Reid International Airport (LAS/KLAS).
